source.title: EntSQL: A Benchmark for Grounding Text-to-SQL in Long-Context Enterprise Knowledge

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing text-to-SQL benchmarks overlook enterprise scenarios where SQL generation depends on proprietary business knowledge. EntSQL measures the ability to ground SQL generation in long-context enterprise documents, revealing a significant performance gap in current systems.
